scandinavian-design-trends-2026.title: Scandinavian Design Trends for 2026
scandinavian-design-trends-2026.excerpt: Discover the latest Scandinavian design trends shaping modern interiors this year, from warm minimalism to nature-inspired textures.
scandinavian-design-trends-2026.content:
The Evolution of Nordic Design

Scandinavian design continues to evolve in 2026, embracing warmer tones and organic materials while maintaining its hallmark simplicity. This year, we see a shift toward what designers call 'warm minimalism' — spaces that feel both clean and inviting.

Key Trends

  • Warm Neutrals: Beige, camel, and terracotta replace stark whites
  • Curved Furniture: Soft, rounded forms dominate new collections
  • Natural Textures: Bouclé, linen, and raw wood take center stage
  • Japandi Influence: The fusion of Japanese and Scandinavian aesthetics deepens

These trends reflect a growing desire for homes that feel like sanctuaries — calm, warm, and deeply personal.

small-space-furniture-guide.title: The Ultimate Small-Space Furniture Guide
small-space-furniture-guide.excerpt: Make the most of compact living with our expert tips on choosing multifunctional furniture that maximizes every square meter.
small-space-furniture-guide.content:
Living Large in Small Spaces

Urban living often means making the most of limited square footage. The right furniture choices can transform a cramped apartment into a functional, stylish home.

Multi-Functional Pieces

Look for furniture that serves double duty: storage ottomans, extendable dining tables, and sofa beds with hidden storage compartments.

Scale Matters

Choose furniture proportional to your space. A slim-profile sofa can make a small living room feel much more open than an oversized sectional.

Vertical Storage

  • Wall-mounted shelving systems
  • Tall, narrow bookcases
  • Over-door organizers
  • Floating nightstands

Remember: in small spaces, every piece of furniture should earn its place.

living-room-color-palettes.title: Color Palettes That Transform Your Living Room
living-room-color-palettes.excerpt: From serene neutrals to bold accents, explore color combinations that bring personality and warmth to your living space.
living-room-color-palettes.content:
The Power of Color

Color is one of the most powerful tools in interior design. The right palette can make a room feel larger, cozier, more energetic, or more serene.

Trending Palettes for 2026

  • Forest & Sage: Deep greens paired with soft sage and cream
  • Warm Earth: Terracotta, rust, and warm beige
  • Ocean Calm: Navy, soft blue, and sandy neutrals
  • Modern Blush: Dusty pink with charcoal and gold accents

Tips for Implementation

Start with a base neutral, add your main color through larger pieces like sofas and rugs, then layer accent colors through cushions, artwork, and accessories.

sustainable-materials-furniture.title: Sustainable Materials in Modern Furniture
sustainable-materials-furniture.excerpt: Learn about eco-friendly materials revolutionizing furniture manufacturing and how to make environmentally conscious choices.
sustainable-materials-furniture.content:
Building a Greener Future

The furniture industry is undergoing a sustainability revolution. Consumers increasingly demand eco-friendly options, and manufacturers are responding with innovative materials and processes.

Materials to Look For

  • FSC-Certified Wood: Sourced from responsibly managed forests
  • Recycled Metals: Aluminum and steel with high recycled content
  • Organic Fabrics: GOTS-certified cotton, linen, and hemp
  • Bamboo: Fast-growing, renewable, and incredibly versatile
  • Cork: Harvested without cutting trees, naturally renewable

What to Avoid

Steer clear of furniture containing formaldehyde-based adhesives, PVC, and non-recyclable composite materials. Look for certifications like Greenguard, OEKO-TEX, and Cradle to Cradle.

home-office-setup-guide.title: The Perfect Home Office Setup
home-office-setup-guide.excerpt: Create a productive and comfortable workspace at home with our comprehensive guide to ergonomic furniture and smart layouts.
home-office-setup-guide.content:
Designing Your Workspace

A well-designed home office can dramatically improve your productivity, comfort, and work-life balance. Here's how to create the perfect setup.

The Essential Desk

Your desk should be at elbow height when seated. Consider a sit-stand desk for flexibility throughout the day. A minimum width of 120cm provides adequate space for a monitor and workspace.

Ergonomic Seating

Invest in a quality office chair with adjustable height, lumbar support, and armrests. Your feet should rest flat on the floor with knees at 90 degrees.

Lighting

  • Position your desk perpendicular to windows to reduce glare
  • Add a quality desk lamp with adjustable color temperature
  • Ensure ambient lighting is sufficient to reduce eye strain

Organization

Cable management, drawer organizers, and wall-mounted storage keep your workspace clean and your mind focused.

bedroom-makeover-inspiration.title: Bedroom Makeover: From Drab to Dream
bedroom-makeover-inspiration.excerpt: Transform your bedroom into a restful sanctuary with these design tips, from choosing the right bed frame to creating the perfect ambiance.
bedroom-makeover-inspiration.content:
Your Personal Retreat

Your bedroom should be your sanctuary — a place where you can truly relax and recharge. Here's how to create a space that promotes rest and reflects your style.

Start with the Bed

The bed is the focal point of any bedroom. Choose a frame that anchors the room and invest in quality bedding. A upholstered headboard adds both comfort and visual warmth.

Layer Your Lighting

  • Overhead: dimmable main light for flexibility
  • Task: bedside lamps for reading
  • Ambient: LED strips or fairy lights for atmosphere

Textiles Make the Room

Layer different textures — a knitted throw, linen sheets, velvet cushions. This creates depth and makes the space feel luxurious and inviting.

Keep It Clutter-Free

A tidy bedroom promotes better sleep. Invest in smart storage solutions and keep surfaces minimal.

0.heading: Introduction
0.content: At PLANQ, we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our website and services. By using our platform, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

1.heading: Information We Collect
1.content:
We collect the following types of information:

  • Personal Data: Name, email address, shipping address, phone number, and payment information when you create an account or place an order.
  • Usage Data: Browsing history, pages visited, products viewed, search queries, and interaction patterns to improve our services.
  • Cookies: We use essential, analytics, and marketing cookies to enhance your experience. See our Cookies section below for details.

2.heading: How We Use Your Information
2.content:
Your information is used to:

  • Process and fulfill your orders
  • Manage your account and provide customer support
  • Send order updates and shipping notifications
  • Personalize your shopping experience
  • Send promotional offers (with your consent)
  • Improve our website and services
  • Prevent fraud and ensure security

3.heading: Data Sharing & Third Parties
3.content: We do not sell your personal data. We share information only with trusted third parties necessary to operate our business: payment processors (Stripe), shipping carriers, email service providers, and analytics tools (Google Analytics). All third parties are bound by data processing agreements.

4.heading: Data Retention
4.content: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. Order data is kept for 7 years for legal and accounting purposes. You may request deletion of your data at any time, subject to legal retention requirements.

5.heading: Your Rights
5.content:
Under GDPR, you have the right to:

  • Access: Request a copy of your personal data
  • Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
  • Erasure: Request deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten')
  • Portability: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
  • Object: Opt out of marketing communications at any time

To exercise these rights, contact us at support@planq.store.

6.heading: Cookies Policy
6.content:
We use the following types of cookies:

  • Essential: Required for the website to function (cart, authentication)
  • Analytics: Help us understand how visitors use our site
  • Marketing: Used for personalized advertising

You can manage cookie preferences through the cookie consent banner or your browser settings.

7.heading: Contact Us
7.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at support@planq.store or visit our Contact page.

We reserve the right to update these terms at any time, and continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of any changes.

We reserve the right to modify prices without prior notice. In the event of a pricing error, we will contact you before processing the order.

4.content: Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery in their original condition and packaging. Custom orders, clearance items, and opened mattresses are non-returnable. Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days after receipt of returned items. Return shipping costs are the buyer's responsibility unless the item is defective.

8.heading: Changes to Terms

0.heading: Shipping Methods
0.content: We offer two shipping methods: Standard Delivery (5-7 business days) and Express Delivery (2-3 business days). Express delivery is available for most items except oversized furniture. All orders are processed within 1-2 business days before shipping.

1.heading: Shipping Rates
1.content: Shipping rates depend on your location and chosen delivery method. See the rates table below for detailed pricing.

2.heading: Free Shipping
2.content: Free standard shipping is available when your order reaches the minimum threshold for your delivery region. Free shipping applies to standard delivery only; express shipping fees still apply.

3.heading: Order Processing Time
3.content: Orders placed before 2:00 PM CET on business days are processed the same day. Orders placed after 2:00 PM or on weekends/holidays are processed the next business day. You'll receive a confirmation email with tracking information once your order ships.

4.heading: Tracking Your Order
4.content: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also track your order in your account under 'My Orders'. Tracking information is typically updated within 24 hours of shipment.

5.heading: Large Items & Furniture Delivery
5.content: Large furniture items require special handling and may have longer delivery times (7-14 business days). These items are delivered to your door by a specialized carrier. White-glove delivery service (unpacking and room placement) is available for an additional fee. Please ensure someone is available to receive the delivery.

6.heading: International Shipping
6.content: We ship throughout the EU and to the UK. International orders may be subject to customs duties and import taxes, which are the responsibility of the recipient. Delivery times for international orders may vary depending on customs processing.

0.heading: 30-Day Return Policy
0.content: We want you to love your purchase. If you're not completely satisfied, you can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be in their original, unused condition with all original packaging and tags.

1.heading: Eligible Items
1.content:
The following items are eligible for return:

  • Furniture in original, unassembled condition
  • Decor and accessories in original packaging
  • Textiles with tags attached and unwashed
  • Lighting fixtures in original packaging

2.heading: Non-Returnable Items
2.content:
The following items cannot be returned:

  • Custom or made-to-order furniture
  • Clearance and final sale items
  • Opened mattresses and bedding (for hygiene reasons)
  • Items that have been assembled, used, or modified
  • Gift cards

3.heading: How to Initiate a Return
3.content:
1. Log into your PLANQ account and go to 'My Orders'
  2. Select the order containing the item you wish to return
  3. Click 'Initiate Return' and select the reason
  4. Print the prepaid return label
  5. Pack the item securely in its original packaging
  6. Drop off at your nearest carrier location or schedule a pickup

4.heading: Refund Process & Timeline
4.content: Once we receive and inspect your returned item, we'll process your refund within 5-10 business days. Refunds are credited to your original payment method. Wallet refunds are processed immediately. Please allow an additional 3-5 business days for the refund to appear on your bank statement.

5.heading: Exchanges
5.content: We do not offer direct exchanges. To get a different item, please return the original item for a refund and place a new order. This ensures the fastest processing time and guarantees stock availability for your desired item.

6.heading: Damaged or Defective Items
6.content: If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us at support@planq.store within 48 hours of delivery. Include photos of the damage and your order number. We'll arrange a free return and send a replacement or issue a full refund, including any shipping costs.
